attackers_goals: Obtain access to credentials stored in the Keychain file.
description: An unusual process accessed a Keychain file. This might indicate a credential-grabbing attempt.
investigative_actions: Determine whether it is legitimate for the process to access credential data directly. Analyze the process/application that touched the Keychain. Check for any other suspicious actions that were performed by the process. Look for unusual access to resources using credentials stored on said Keychain.
name: Rare process accessed a Keychain file
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
